steps.name: Set up job
Check out source
Set up Node.js
Install locked dependencies
Ensure Electron runtime is installed
Verify release tag matches package version
Test circuit engine and editor models
Test update dialog and save-before-restart
Test Windows EXE replacement and rollback
Test device resizing, themes and IDE preferences
Test edge resizing of every device and both surfaces
Test every part model thumbnail and hover preview
Test readable UI text in dark and light themes
Test system appearance, surface movement and unlimited canvas
Test code-only colorscheme registration
Test Electron editing and HAL workflows
Test catalog search, Docs, inline main.c and routed wiring
Test empty canvas, single board, breadboards and inline Docs
Test LED WritePin and persisted circuit diagnostics
Test code reset, undo and legacy Docs preview
Test compact controls, debug shortcuts and board reset
Test TFT frame diagnostics and UART input through Electron
Test onboard USART2 VCP and external UART wiring
Upload test diagnostics on failure
Build portable executable
Verify package and prepare download
Verify update helper from packaged Electron main
Verify updater in the actual portable EXE
Upload Windows download
Add download link to build summary
Post Set up Node.js
Post Check out source
Complete job
